extraction.Name: James Wright
extraction.Refused/Protested: I told the Farmer that I did not want the patent when I found out that it had been issued and ask him to send it back. He said the next time I saw him that he had sent it back but it would necessary for me to take it now as it had been xek2 returned. I took it then.
extraction.Buyer: William M. Kunde; sold one quarter for $7000 (shared with wife's quarter, so $3500 for his quarter); traded other quarter to E. V. Youngquist for some land; sold exchanged land for $1100 in cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I could not work and had to live and the taxes were high, so I had to sell.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at the Farmer's office in Okreek. Does not remember signing a receipt. Wife's quarter and his quarter sold together for $7000; only $4500 received out of $7000, making approximately $2250 for his share; holds a second mortgage on the place for the remainder. Traded second quarter to E. V. Youngquist for land, then sold that exchanged land for $1100 cash. Depended on his Farmer (agency farmer) for guidance. States he was not capable of handling a patent but felt forced to take it. Hopes to get the matter straightened out. Dependents: himself and wife. Notarized before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-3_, on the 7th day of May 1929.
